summary: Adds a /download endpoint that serves files from the upload directory by name. It also changes the dev server to bind all interfaces with debug mode on.

findings.title: Path traversal in download endpoint
findings.problem: The download handler joins the request's name parameter onto UPLOAD_DIR without any check. A name like ../../etc/passwd or an absolute path such as /etc/passwd escapes the upload directory.
findings.consequence: Any client can read any file the server process can open. This includes secrets, config files and source code.
findings.fix: Resolve the joined path and reject it unless it stays under UPLOAD_DIR. Alternatively, use Flask send_from_directory, which performs this check.

findings.title: Debugger enabled on all network interfaces
findings.problem: The change turns on debug mode and switches the bind address from 127.0.0.1 to 0.0.0.0. The interactive Werkzeug debugger then becomes reachable from other hosts.
findings.consequence: Anyone on the network who triggers an error can reach the debugger console. That console runs arbitrary Python on the server.
findings.fix: Keep the loopback host and read the debug flag from configuration or an environment variable that defaults to off.

findings.title: New download endpoint has no covering test
findings.problem: The change adds a download endpoint with a 404 path and a file-serving path. The repository contains no tests that call this endpoint.
findings.consequence: Nothing would catch a regression in its path handling, including a returning traversal bug.
findings.fix: Add tests for a valid file, a missing file, and traversal names such as ../x and /etc/passwd.
